deadline.value: Apply by November 24, 2026 (same for international applicants).
deadline.quote: International Applicants F (student) or J (exchange visitor) visas; A,E,G,H,I and L visas and immigrants November 24, 2026

gre_subject.value: The Chemistry GRE is not required but can help the evaluation.
gre_subject.quote: The chemistry subject GRE score is not required but it can be helpful for a complete evaluation.

gre_general.quote: No, submitting GRE Scores is optional.

supervisor.value: No pre-application supervisor requirement is mentioned.

funding.value: Every admitted PhD student gets a graduate assistantship for the whole program while in good standing; no separate application.
funding.quote: The Chemistry and Biochemistry department offers a graduate assistantship to all admitted PhD students for the duration of the program as long as they are in good standing.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's degree that includes at least 30 semester hours of chemistry.
entry_route.quote: Admission to graduate study at the University of Maryland requires a minimum of a Bachelor of Science (B.S.), Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) or equivalent degree.

notes: Biochemistry (BCHM) is a separate PhD in the same department with the same admissions FAQ.
